TestUserTypes::test_add_udt_to_another_d.description: 3-node cluster, keyspace RF=1. Builds a 'real-life' schema: nested frozen UDTs (obs_entity contains user_refs), tables entity/entity_rel using them, 5 secondary indexes, 2 materialized views on entity. Inserts 2000 rows into each table from 2 threads, asserts counts, then ALTER TYPE obs_entity/user_refs ADD a new frozen UDT field, inserts 10 rows using the new fields and asserts counts on base tables and both MVs. Guards ALTER TYPE propagation to tables+views (schema merge with base/view mutations).

origin.summary: Complex schema with alter type (added together with test_alter_inner_udt_by_another_udt); PR body has no linked issue.

commits.0a99ae46cc: File-level: populate via cluster_topology_3_nodes (3 racks) instead of populate(3); keyspace RF stays 1.

TestUserTypes::test_add_udt_to_another_d.relevance: Live: UDTs, ALTER TYPE ADD, secondary indexes, MVs all supported. The test caught real regression scylladb#15530 (2023, 'Invalid tuple literal ... not of type frozen<user_refs>' after ALTER TYPE; root cause: schema-hash removal in Raft mode losing base mutations when UDT referenced by both base and view; reverted 35849fc901, fixed by 3582095b79 which added no scylla test).

TestUserTypes::test_add_udt_to_another_d.reason: Would be GREEN: only test exercising ALTER TYPE on a UDT referenced by base table + MVs + indexes on multi-node; it caught scylladb#15530 and the fix 3582095b79 added no scylla test. Note: DEBUG driver logging (70425b251f) is leftover instrumentation for closed scylladb#15530. Note: post-ALTER checks are row counts only (10 altered rows overwrite existing keys, count unchanged), and MV counts use assert_row_count with num_attempts=1 (tools/assertions.py:255) despite async view updates with RF=1 on 3 nodes; ThreadPoolExecutors never shut down.

TestUserTypes::test_case_sensitive_type_.description: 3-node RF=3, LOCAL_QUORUM. Creates quoted type "PHone" and uses it as non-frozen column, frozen column and frozen<list<"PHone">>; inserts/reads back values. Then creates lowercase type phone with different field types, same three tables, insert/readback; finally drops "PHone" tables and type and checks phone-based data is intact. Guards scylla fix de1171181c (case-sensitive UDT names failed CREATE TABLE with 'Unknown type ks.phone').
